parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: Name of the application gateway.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --custom-error-pages
parameters.help: Space-separated list of custom error pages in `STATUS_CODE=URL` format.

parameters.name: --location
parameters.help: Location. You can configure the default location using `az configure --defaults location=<location>`.

parameters.name: --max-capacity
parameters.help: Upper bound on the number of application gateway instances.

parameters.name: --min-capacity
parameters.help: Lower bound on the number of application gateway instances.

parameters.name: --no-wait
parameters.help: Do not wait for the long-running operation to finish.

parameters.name: --priority
parameters.help: Priority of the request routing rule. Supported SKU tiers are Standard_v2, WAF_v2.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.help: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value]...]. Use '' to clear existing tags.

parameters.name: --validate
parameters.help: Generate and validate the ARM template without creating any resources.

parameters.name: --waf-policy
parameters.help: Name or ID of a web application firewall (WAF) policy.

parameters.name: --zones
parameters.help: Space-separated list of availability zones into which to provision the resource.

parameters.name: --capacity
parameters.help: The number of instances to use with the application gateway.

parameters.name: --cert-file
parameters.help: The path to the PFX certificate file.

parameters.name: --cert-password
parameters.help: The certificate password.

parameters.name: --connection-draining-timeout
parameters.help: The time in seconds after a backend server is removed during which on open connection remains active. Range: 0 (disabled) to 3600.

parameters.name: --enable-fips
parameters.help: Whether FIPS is enabled on the application gateway resource.

parameters.name: --frontend-port
parameters.help: The front end port number.

parameters.name: --http-settings-cookie-based-affinity
parameters.help: Enable or disable HTTP settings cookie-based affinity.

parameters.name: --http-settings-port
parameters.help: The HTTP settings port.

parameters.name: --http-settings-protocol
parameters.help: The HTTP settings protocol.

parameters.name: --http2
parameters.help: Use HTTP2 for the application gateway.

parameters.name: --key-vault-secret-id
parameters.help: Secret Id of (base-64 encoded unencrypted pfx) 'Secret' or 'Certificate' object stored in Azure KeyVault. You need enable soft delete for keyvault to use this feature.

parameters.name: --routing-rule-type
parameters.help: The request routing rule type.

parameters.name: --servers
parameters.help: Space-separated list of IP addresses or DNS names corresponding to backend servers.

parameters.name: --sku
parameters.help: The name of the SKU.

parameters.name: --ssl-certificate-name
parameters.help: The certificate name. Default will be `<application- gateway-name>SslCert`.

parameters.name: --ssl-profile-id
parameters.help: SSL profile resource of the application gateway. WARNING: Argument '--ssl-profile-id' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --identity
parameters.help: Name or ID of the ManagedIdentity Resource.

parameters.name: --trusted-client-cert
parameters.help: The application gateway trusted client certificate. Usage: --trusted-client-certificates name=client1 data=client.cer name: Required. Name of the trusted client certificate that is unique within an Application Gateway data: Required. Certificate public data. Multiple trusted client certificates can be specified by using more than one `--trusted- client-certificates` argument. WARNING: Argument '--trusted-client-cert' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --private-ip-address
parameters.help: Static private IP address to use.

parameters.name: --public-ip-address
parameters.help: Name or ID of a public IP address. Uses existing resource or creates new if specified, or none if omitted.

parameters.name: --public-ip-address-allocation
parameters.help: The kind of IP allocation to use when creating a new public IP.

parameters.name: --subnet
parameters.help: Name or ID of the subnet. Will create resource if it does not exist. If name specified, also specify --vnet- name. If you want to use an existing subnet in other resource group or subscription, please provide the ID instead of the name of the subnet.

parameters.name: --subnet-address-prefix
parameters.help: The CIDR prefix to use when creating a new subnet.

parameters.name: --vnet-address-prefix
parameters.help: The CIDR prefix to use when creating a new VNet.

parameters.name: --vnet-name
parameters.help: The virtual network (VNet) name.

parameters.name: --enable-private-link
parameters.help: Enable Private Link feature for this application gateway. If both public IP and private IP are enbaled, taking effect only in public frontend IP.

parameters.name: --private-link-ip-address
parameters.help: The static private IP address of a subnet for Private Link. If omitting, a dynamic one will be created.

parameters.name: --private-link-primary
parameters.help: Whether the IP configuration is primary or not.

parameters.name: --private-link-subnet
parameters.help: The name of the subnet within the same vnet of an application gateway.

parameters.name: --private-link-subnet-prefix
parameters.help: The CIDR prefix to use when creating a new subnet.

parameters.name: --ssl-profile
parameters.help: The application gateway ssl profiles. Usage: --ssl-profile name=MySslProfile client-auth-configuration=True cipher- suites=TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 policy-type=Custom min-protocol-version=TLSv1_0 name: Required. Name of the SSL profile that is unique within an Application Gateway. polic-name: Name of Ssl Policy. policy-type: Type of Ssl Policy. min-protocol-version: Minimum version of Ssl protocol to be supported on application gateway. cipher-suites: Ssl cipher suites to be enabled in the specified order to application gateway. disabled-ssl-protocols: Space-separated list of protocols to disable. trusted-client-certificates: Array of references to application gateway trusted client certificates. client-auth-configuration: Client authentication configuration of the application gateway resource. Multiple ssl profiles can be specified by using more than one `--ssl-profile` argument. WARNING: Argument '--ssl-profile' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
